text_block_list.text:
Although Бива Хаяхидэ comes away
victorious
from the Satsuki Sho, she can't
help but feel that
something about her
calculations is off.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Таисин's fierce competitive spirit
is a value
that her equation can't
account for.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And then there's Уиннинг Тикит and her
undying
determination to win the
Japanese Derby...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The Japanese Derby is the stage where
the three
rivals will meet again, but can
Biwa Hayahide
quell her anxiety before
then?
text_block_list.name: Монолог
